title: The coverage report has no verdict
statement: The tool reports gaps and teams decide what to do about them: status reports each area's coverage as counts and lists, never one blended score, as text and stable JSON.

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each area (implementation, health, stories, personas, design, quality) status reports how many are covered, with the lists of what is and is not.

A gap is a finding, never a failure: status exits zero, and non-zero only when it cannot produce a trustworthy report (a malformed Saga, duplicate IDs, or a checkout that does not match the declared repository).
The report is readable as text and emitted as stable JSON whose shape is a contract; the docs teach common CI rules as recipes rather than flags.
Status emits ordered next_actions, each a command or one focused question.
